effects.description: Redirects a percentage of all incoming damage from the recipient of the buff to the caster of the buff. The recipient takes the remainder of the damage as normal.

bio: When Virtus was young, he dreamed only of being a hero – valiant, righteous, and honorable, even to a fault. He achieved those dreams, but discovered at the end of that road that family was worth far more than dreams ever could be.
